snippet.title: On My Watch - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
ON MY WATCH is a first-person psychological horror game set in a hospital after hours. Make your rounds, check the security cameras, and talk to the people still awake. There’s more going on here than anyone is willing to tell you.
Explore at your own pace, uncover what’s been hidden, and decide what to do with the truth. Your choices can lead you to different paths.

Wishlist now on steam!!

Developed by mooshuno.



#OnMyWatch #PsychologicalHorror #IndieHorror
